data.title: Pudgy Penguins-backed Abstract to shut down after ‘tens of millions’ in losses
data.summary_raw: Igloo CEO Luca Netz said the company funded Abstract for 18 months but still failed to find product-market fit despite attracting major brands and a community of millions.

data.title: Conduit sues Tether over allegedly freezing $2.8M without explanation
data.summary_raw: The lawsuit alleged that Tether froze USDt funds in a Conduit wallet tied to an investigation launched by Brazilian authorities in 2024.

data.title: Winklevoss-backed Zcash ETF files with SEC for Nasdaq listing
